integrity: The theorem is proved algebraically using Newton identities, exact finite-field multiset counting, the Chinese remainder theorem, and the published affine-symmetry synthesis identity.
The finite verifier independently exhausts the local congruence count for several primes and is supplementary rather than a substitute for the general proof.
No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact endpoint criterion is proved only for squarefree moduli with no prime factor 2 or 3.
Prime-power and other nonsquarefree local factors at the sixth moment remain undetermined here.
The literature search cannot exclude an uncatalogued occurrence of the same squarefree CRT/Newton calculation.
title: Exact squarefree endpoint profile for the cubic moment curve
